out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO SIGNED COPIES OF THE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY WAS AVAILABLE ON SITE FOR REVIEW AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH EMPLOYEE SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND POST FOR USE WHEN NECESSARY.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS AND RAW FISH STORED ABOVE PREPARED VEGETABLES AND READY TO EAT FOODS IN AVANTCO 3 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW LAMB IN AVANTCO 3 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR,
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.observation: OBSERVED FROZEN REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGED SALMON THAWING IN SEALED PACKAGES IN AVANTCO 3 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO OPEN OR REMOVE FROM PACKAGING AND RETURN TO REFRIGERATOR TO CONTINUE THAWING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BEVERAGES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED BEVERAGES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: UTENSILS IN DISHWASHING MACHINE WITH SANITIZER MEASURED AT 0PPM AT END OF CLEANING CYCLE AFTER SEVERAL ATTEMPTS.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SET UP SANITIZER BASIN IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR SANITIZING KITCHENWARE AND DISHES UNTIL DISHWASHING MACHINE IS REPAIRED. PIC PLACED SERVICE REQUEST DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT IS REPAIRED AND CAN SANITIZE DISHES AT 50-200PPM CHLORINE SANITIZER.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS AND SAUCES WITHOUT LABELS ON PREP TOP AND NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC STARTED REMOVING CASES DURING INSPECTION. out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHING MACHINE UNABLE TO SANITIZE DISHES AT 50-200PPM FOR CHLORINE SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR SANITIZING UNTIL UNIT IS REPAIRED AND CAN DISPENSE CHLORINE SANITIZER AT 50- 200PPM DURING THE SANITIZING CYCLE. PIC REQUESTED SERVICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE SERVICE HAS BEEN COMPLETED.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MICE DROPPINGS UNDER SHELVING IN STORAGE HALLWAY BETWEEN KITCHEN AND FRONT SERVICE. PEST CONTROL SERVICE REPORTS WERE NOT AVAILABLE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EDUCATION PROVIDED. out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: ONLINE MENU WITHOUT DISCLOSURE STATEMENT AND LAMB OR OTHER ANIMAL PROTEINS WHICH MAY BE SERVED UNDERCOOKED OR RAW IDENTIFIED WITH ASTERISKS.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE UPDATE MENU TO INCLUDE DISCLOSURE STATEMENT ”* THIS ITEM MAY BE SERVED UNDERCOOKED OR RAW” AND IDENTIFY APPLICABLE FOODS ON MENU WITH THE ASTERISK “*” COMPLIANCE WILL. BE CONFIRMED IN FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
